_about: Public-domain Charles Gore (1853-1932, Bishop of Oxford, founder of the Community of the Resurrection) for the Word Hoard: 20 books from Internet Archive scans, from the Bampton Lectures on the Incarnation (1891) and the Dissertations (1895) through the practical expositions of the Sermon on the Mount, Ephesians and Romans, The Body of Christ, The Ministry of the Christian Church, to the Reconstruction of Belief trilogy (1921-1924) and Jesus of Nazareth (1929). Written in English. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 27 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
